in_sanskrit.name: Tushal
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Mountain rest
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Tushal एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Tushal is a Sanskrit and Hindi name that means mountain rest. It is derived from the Sanskrit word Tushas, which means calm, peaceful, and serene.
